title: Clarify token attribution for preempted/partially-served streams
creator: Ava Chen
description: Investigate and fix correctness gaps in the metering pipeline when responses are preempted (quota enforcement, server-side truncation, or early termination). Current behavior can undercount or double-charge tokens across retries and partial-stream events. Goal: ensure deterministic, idempotent token attribution for streamed responses and provide reconciliation tooling for historical anomalies.
comments: 2025-01-22 - Triage: reported by Billing team after customer incident where a long streaming response was preemptively cut by quota enforcement and the customer was charged 2x for overlapping retries. Initial hypothesis: client retries + missing final token summary event in the stream cause both duplicate and missing accounting records.

2025-01-24 - Design meeting notes: decide to add a server-assigned request_trace_id (UUID) propagated through stream chunks + finalization record that contains canonical token counts (input_tokens, output_tokens, cumulative_tokens). This allows upstream metering to commit only once per trace_id. See Confluence: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/ENG/Token+Attribution+Docs

2025-01-27 - Implementation started: add Request-Trace header in runtime proxy and include 'metering_summary' control event at end-of-stream. Proto spec updated in repo (RFC in PR). Draft PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/inference/pull/2314

2025-01-30 - Review feedback from Storage team: need atomic ledger writes. We will change from separate events to a two-phase commit in metering pipeline: (1) write provisional record keyed by trace_id, (2) on finalization event, set committed=true + write canonical token counts. This prevents double-commit on replay.

2025-02-02 - QA notes: simulated client retry scenarios using SDK harness (retries at 408/500). Observed that provisional records were being left open for >5m for slow clients; decided to add TTL for provisional records and an asynchronous reconciliation job to close them after 10m with best-effort counts.
2025-02-04 - Security review request: because we persist trace_id and token counts, privacy review requested for logs retention. Ticket sent to SecOps. Sec review required: true.

2025-02-05 - Rollout plan: incremental canary on region-us-east-1 for 48h, monitoring: billing_reconciliation_mismatch_rate, duplicate_metering_write_rate, median-finalization-latency. Dashboard: https://grafana.redwood.ai/d/XYZ/metering-pipeline
